title: NASA didn't want to talk after news called them
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of NASA didn't want to talk after news called them, about 2024-2025 at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> Well, from what I heard was just something I mentioned got the attention of the news and the news called NASA and NASA's like, "God, we don't want to talk about this."

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he draws UFOs to him and that NASA, the US space agency, has studied him, tells what he heard from a friend at the CIA in Washington around 2024 or 2025. According to Bledsoe, something he said caught the attention of the news, reporters called NASA, and NASA's reaction was that it did not want to talk about it. He tells it as a sign that the agency knows more than it says.
